text: DSH Free Models · opencode（DSH 网页客户端插件）：把 OpenCode Zen 免费车道的模型接入 DSH 的 opencode 模型提供方。插件在模型设置页提供目录刷新、模型勾选和即时探测界面，并将所选模型注册给 DSH；未勾选时提供方不展示模型。用户可查看模型能力信息、选择要使用的模型并逐个确认可用性，随后通过该提供方发送对话。适合希望在 DSH 中浏览并使用 OpenCode Zen 免费模型的用户。刷新目录会连接 OpenCode Zen 和 models.dev；对话内容发送至 OpenCode Zen，不需要用户填写 API Key。

DSH Free Models · opencode brings OpenCode Zen free models to DSH. The settings card refreshes the catalogue, selects models, and probes availability; selected models appear in the opencode provider. Conversations go to OpenCode Zen; catalogue metadata comes from models.dev. No API key is required.
想在 DSH 里浏览并使用 OpenCode Zen 的免费模型。
能不能刷新免费模型清单，勾选需要的模型接入 DSH？
I want to check which free models respond before choosing one in DSH.
DSH Free Models · opencode 的功能「免费模型目录与选择」：在模型设置卡刷新 OpenCode Zen 模型目录并显示模型信息，用户勾选的模型才会由 opencode 提供方呈现给 DSH。
DSH Free Models · opencode 的功能「模型可用性探测」：用户可从设置卡发起单模型探测或对已选模型逐个探测，并在卡片中查看可用、限流等结果。
DSH Free Models · opencode 使用前须知：模型对话请求会发送到 opencode.ai 的 Zen 服务；实现使用公开标记而不要求用户提供 API Key。
DSH Free Models · opencode 使用前须知：刷新模型目录会请求 opencode.ai，模型能力元数据还会从 models.dev 获取。
DSH Free Models · opencode 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 21 天；提交数 15；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

DSH Free Models · opencode README · dsh-freemodels-opencode：把 **opencode Zen 免费车道**的模型接进 DeepSeek Harness，并且解决"这堆模型到底哪个能用"这个手工问题：

- **刷新模型**：一键从上游重新拉清单（含 models.dev 的上下文窗口、弃用标记）。
- **勾选启用**：勾上的模型才会以 provider `opencode` 出现在模型选择器里；**一个都不勾 = 一个都不显示**。
- **测试能不能用**：对单个模型或全部已勾选模型发一个真实尺寸的请求，给出九档结论，而不是让你自己瞎试。
- **按能力排序**：每个模型带一枚 S/A/B/C 人工评级徽章，卡片和模型选择器用同一个顺序，最强的排最前。

界面在 **设置 → 模型** 页底部，标题「opencode 免费模型」。

本插件是独立项目，**不修改也不依赖** [`@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin`](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh)。两者可以共存：原插件负责它自己的 provider，本插件负责 provider `opencode`。

DSH Free Models · opencode README · 为什么需要它：上游 `https://opencode.ai/zen/v1/models` 现在返回 86 个模型 id，其中大部分是付费模型。本插件**在拉取时就把付费的丢掉**，当前只留免费车道的 9 个，所以卡片里、探测队列里、状态文件里都不会出现付费 id。

免费车道的判定不只看 `-free` 后缀：`big-pickle` 不带后缀也在车道上，反过来有些模型带 free 却在黑名单里。

剩下这一点是静态清单回答不了的：免费车道随时会因为限流、区域封锁、上游策略变化而失效，**同一个模型几小时前 200、现在 429**。所以"能不能用"只能是**实时观测**，本插件就是这么做的。

DSH Free Models · opencode README · 安装：```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-freemodels-opencode
```

或者从源码装：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/xiean676/dsh-freemodels-opencode.git
cd dsh-freemodels-opencode
npm install --ignore-scripts
npm run build

装完重启 Harness，进 **设置 → 模型**，滚到最底下就是卡片。

> 桌面版的设置页在 Electron 里，本插件的桥接走同源 HTTP；如果卡片显示"读不到插件状态"，说明桌面端没把 `webServer` 服务暴露给插件，此时勾选和探测不可用（provider 本身仍然正常工作，用的是上次保存的勾选）。

DSH Free Models · opencode README · 界面怎么用：1. 点 **刷新模型** —— 拉一次清单。首次装完会自动拉一次。列表里只有免费模型。
2. 勾想要的模型。勾上的才会出现在模型选择器里。
3. 点某个模型右边的 **测试** —— 发一个真实尺寸的请求（96 token 上限，而不是一个 ping），几百毫秒到几十秒出结论。**上游一有内容就立刻判「可用」**，不用等整段流读完。
4. 或者点 **测试已勾选（N）** —— 串行测一遍已经勾上的。遇到「需付费」「车道额度用尽」，或者带 5 分钟以上 `retry-after` 的「被限流」就立刻停：这三种结论对剩下的模型必然一样，继续测只会烧掉你在等的那段额度。
   - 批量测试会**先让你确认一次**（按钮变成「确认测试 N 个模型？」），因为它真的会发 N 次请求、消耗 N 份免费额度。
   - 同一个模型 **60 秒内不会重复测**，重复点只会得到「刚测过」，不会再发请求。
DSH Free Models · opencode README · 界面怎么用：> 免费车道的判定是启发式的（黑名单 → 已知白名单 → models.dev 零价 → 名字含 free）。如果某个刚上线的免费模型没被识别出来，或者某个付费模型混了进来，点 **刷新模型** 会重新判定；判定逻辑在 `src/catalog.ts` 的 `isFreeLane`。

DSH Free Models · opencode README · 排序与评级：卡片上方有三个排序按钮，默认 **按能力**：

| 排序 | 含义 |
| --- | --- |
| 按能力 | 按评级从高到低，评级相同再按上下文量 —— 和模型选择器里的顺序完全一致 |
| 按名称 | 按模型名字母排 |
| 按上下文 | 按上下文窗口从大到小 |

每行左边的 **S/A/B/C 徽章是人工评级，不是跑分结果**。它是对这批模型「干长活儿稳不稳」的手工判断，分 S（90+）、A（80+）、B（70+）、C 四段；鼠标悬停徽章会看到每个模型的具体理由。想调整顺序就编辑插件里的 `src/rank.ts` —— 改分数和理由都在那儿，其余代码不用动。

没在人工表里的新模型会走关键词启发式打分（看 id 里的版本号和 `flash`/`preview` 这类档位词），并且**被压到人工评级之下**（上限 63 分），所以明天上游冒出来的新模型只会排到列表末尾，不会顶掉谁。

DSH Free Models · opencode README · 排序与评级：启发式按 `-` / `_` / `.` 分词后**整词匹配**：早期版本用子串判断，于是 `minimax-m3.1-flash-free` 里的 `max` 被当成「高档模型」加分、还把后面的 `flash` 扣分 break 掉了。现在 `minimax` 不再命中 `max`，`flash` 也照常扣分。

上游清单是活的：`space-bunny-free` 和 `longcat-2.5-preview-free` 在 2026-10 已被撤下，但人工表里**保留**了它们的条目（96 / 74 分）—— 上游哪天恢复，插件自动把它们放回原位，不用改代码。

上下文窗口后缀 K/M 按 2 的幂换算（262144 → 256K），手写整数（200000 → 200K）按 1000 换算，两种上游数字都能对上数据手册。

DSH Free Models · opencode README · 九档结论：| 结论 | 含义 | 该怎么办 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 可用 | 上游真的答完了这次请求，不是只回了个 200 | 用 |
| 被限流 | 429 `FreeUsageLimitError`，这个出口的额度暂时用完；有 `retry-after` 会显示「约 N 秒/分钟后可再试」 | 等到那个时间点再测，**不是不可用** |
| 车道额度用尽 | 403 `FreeTierError`：车道按客户端指纹拒绝了这台机器 | 换模型也没用，只能等上游放开，或者去用 opencode 本体 |
| 需付费 | 401/403 `AuthError`：匿名车道没有这个模型的凭据 | 换免费车道的模型 |
| 区域受限 | 403 `RegionError`：模型存在，但你当前出口 IP 所在国家/地区被拒 | 换网络出口 |
| 上游不提供 | 400：上游不认识这个 id，或不用 chat-completions 协议 | 别选它 |
| 上游临时故障 | 5xx `Upstream request failed`：上游网关自己没接住这次请求 | **和这个模型无关**，过一会儿重测 |
| 刚测过 | 60 秒内测过同一个模型，这次没发请求 | 想再测等一分钟 |
| 未测出 | 超时、空响应 | 重测；**不代表不可用** |

DSH Free Models · opencode README · 九档结论：「上游临时故障」是单拎出来的一档：上游 5xx 说的是网关自己没接住，跟这个模型能不能用没有半点关系，混进「未测出」会让人以为模型坏了。

「被限流」和「可用」分开是有代价的：探测请求从 `ping` + 16 token 改成了一段要求数到 30 的真任务 + 96 token 上限。太小的请求只证明"那一刻还有一点点额度"，正好会造出你说的那种"测着可用、一问就 429"。现在测出来可用，就意味着这条链路刚刚真的完整答完过一次。

结论只在当前会话里存在，不落盘 —— 限流会过期，把"不可用"写进磁盘会一直骗人。

DSH Free Models · opencode README · 推理档位：免费模型全部声明支持推理档位，但各自能选的不一样：`space-bunny-free` / `beam-free` 是 low/medium/high/xhigh/max，`nemotron-3.5-super-vl-free` 最全（none→xhigh），`deepseek-v4.1-flash-free` 和 `glm-5.3-flash-free` 只有 low/high/max，而 `big-pickle` / `mimo-v2.6-flash-free` / `longcat-2.5-preview-free` / `nemotron-3.5-lightning-free` 上游没声明，插件就给默认四档 **off / low / high / max**。

DSH Free Models · opencode README · 推理档位：默认四档是实测过这条车道能接受的写法，中间档（medium）被故意去掉：档位写错是每一轮都硬 400，而不是降级。你想改成别的档位表，改 `src/adapter.ts` 的 `DEFAULT_EFFORT_LADDER` —— 顺带说明，DSH 自带的 `dsh-thinking-slider`「补齐四档」功能在这里没用，它改的是 `llm-pi-ai` 的 provider 表，而 `opencode` 是本插件自己的 provider。

插件把这些声明从 models.dev 读进目录，通过 `LlmAdapter.resolveModel()` 的 `reasoning.efforts` 交给 harness，所以你才能在模型选择器里看到档位、选得动。选中的档位在请求里落成 `reasoning_effort`（`off` 发出去是 `none`）。

如果某个模型在 DSH 里还是选不到档位：先点 **刷新模型** 重新拉一次元数据，再重启 DSH。档位来自目录，目录没刷新就不会出现在选择器里。

DSH Free Models · opencode README · 推理档位：models.dev 是个 5.8 MB 的大文档，实测要 15 秒左右，超时也不少见。所以插件把超时放宽到 90 秒并重试一次；**万一还是失败，模型会沿用上次成功拉到的档位和窗口，而不是被清空** —— 一次抓取失败不该让你重新选一遍档位。

**刷新分两步走**：点「刷新模型」只拉 Zen 清单（一般一秒内返回），models.dev 的元数据在后台补全，卡片会在 15 秒 / 60 秒 / 150 秒自动跟进刷新。这样那个 5.8 MB 的文档再慢，也不会让你盯着一个转圈的按钮。

拉 Zen 清单本身也会失败 —— 本机 node 的 DNS 解析器解析 `opencode.ai` 会间歇性超时（`.NET` 的解析器却一直正常），所以这里加了 1 次重试 + 1.5 秒退避，超时放宽到 45 秒。失败时卡片会把错误翻成人话（域名解析失败 / 连接被重置 / TLS 协商失败 / 证书校验失败 / 请求超时），而不是甩一句 `fetch failed`。
DSH Free Models · opencode README · 上下文未知是什么意思：卡片上如果显示「上下文未知」，说明 models.dev 这次没有这个模型的记录，那两个数字只是插件的兜底常数，不是任何人公布的值。这时插件不会把 262144 印出来冒充真实窗口，你点 **刷新模型** 重试即可。
section: 上下文未知是什么意思

text:
DSH Free Models · opencode README · 会话里失败时：真发消息时撞上限流，不再套用 harness 默认的「5 次重试、每次等几百毫秒到 10 秒」——那条策略会把同一次拒绝重花五遍，最后仍然失败，只是多等十几秒。插件通过 `providerRetryPolicy()` 声明自己的策略：

- `RATE_LIMIT` **不重试**。429 带的窗口是分钟到小时级，一轮对话里重试等于白烧。
- `AUTH`、`LANE_EXHAUSTED`、`REGION_BLOCKED`、`MODEL_UNAVAILABLE` 不重试。这些换 key、换模型、等一会儿都不会自己好。
- 只对 `EMPTY_RESPONSE`、`TIMEOUT`、`TRANSPORT` 重试 1 次。

失败消息里会带上游给的等待窗口，例如「opencode: Rate limit exceeded. Please try again later.（上游建议 20 小时后再试）」，不必自己猜。装没装 `llm-retry` 插件都一样：没装就是直接失败并显示这句话，装了也应该只看到一次。

DSH Free Models · opencode README · 自己测：```bash
npm run typecheck   # 宿主 + 客户端两套 tsconfig
npm run check       # build + 三组离线冒烟，全都不打上游
npm run selftest    # 17 组：会话头、清单、评级、档位、分类、存储、路由、adapter、SSE、bundle
npm run render      # 用真 React 渲染构建产物里那张卡，验首帧不崩

`integration.mjs` 把宿主真的 `LlmRuntime` 拉起来跑一遍注册与流式，能抓到离线用例抓不到的契约漂移。宿主把 `@deepseek-ai/*` 打进 `app.asar`，普通 node 进程 import 不了，所以要用解包出来的依赖树：

```bash
FMO_HOST_MODULES=/path/to/extracted/@deepseek-ai/tree node scripts/integration.mjs
```

没设这个变量就跳过，不算失败。

DSH Free Models · opencode README · 自己测：`refresh-now.mjs` 会真打上游并真写 state 文件，所以**故意不挂在 `npm run check` 上** —— 只在旧版本把缓存搞脏、又不想重启 DSH 时手动跑一次。

`render` 和 `interaction` 需要 `react-dom`，`interaction` 还需要 `jsdom`。两者都是 devDependency，装了 `node_modules` 就有；缺了会跳过而不是失败。

DSH Free Models · opencode README · 它怎么实现的（给想改的人）：| 文件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `src/zen-ids.ts` | 免费车道要求的 `ses_*` 会话 id 与 7 个伪装头 |
| `src/rank.ts` | 人工评级表与能力排序（**改顺序只需要动这个文件**） |
| `src/catalog.ts` | 拉 Zen 清单 + models.dev 元数据，**丢掉付费模型**后合并出 `ModelMeta[]` |
| `src/probe.ts` | 单模型探测与九档分类（永不抛异常，流式判级） |
| `src/net-errors.ts` | 把 `fetch failed` 翻成人话：DNS 失败 / 连接重置 / TLS / 证书 / 超时 |
| `src/store.ts` | `$DSH_HOME/data/dsh-freemodels-opencode/state.json`，串行写、原子替换 |
| `src/adapter.ts` | provider `opencode` 的 `LlmAdapter`：只列勾选的、流式转发 |
| `src/bridge.ts` | 四条同源路由：`/status` `/refresh` `/select` `/probe`（探测走 NDJSON 流式返回） |
| `src/index.ts` | 宿主入口：注册 adapter、首轮加载清单、挂路由 |
| `src/client/` | 浏览器入口 + 卡片（只 require `react`） |
section: 它怎么实现的（给想改的人）

text:
DSH Free Models · opencode README · 它怎么实现的（给想改的人）：关键设计：**模型清单的权威是这个插件自己**。`LlmAdapter.listModels()` 返回的就是勾选集，勾选为空时返回 `[]` —— 宿主允许空目录，于是模型选择器里干干净净什么都不显示，正是要的行为。

模型选择器里的顺序也是 `rank.ts` 定的能力序，不是勾选顺序：能力值、上下文窗口、档位深度都进 `src/store.ts` 的 `#advertised()` 指纹，任一变化都会触发重新发布，所以改评级不用重启 DSH。
section: 它怎么实现的（给想改的人）

text:
DSH Free Models · opencode README · 许可：MIT。`src/zen-ids.ts` / 免费车道闸门 / models.dev 解码 / 错误分类的原始协议工作来自 [opencode2dsh](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh)（MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 FishBottle7），详见 [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](./THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)。

上游服务由 OpenCode 运营，与本项目无关。

DSH Free Models · opencode README · v0.3.0：- **人工评级补两条**：`minimax-m3.1-flash-free` 定为 87（A 段，1M 上下文 + 512K 输出 + 档位齐全，新上线稳定性未验证所以压一档），`flint-40b-free` 定为 71（B 段下沿）。上游已撤下但保留条目的 `space-bunny-free` / `longcat-2.5-preview-free` 加了注释说明。
- **修启发式的子串误命中**：档位词改成按 `-` / `_` / `.` 分词后整词匹配。`minimax` 里的 `max` 不再被当成「高档模型」加分，`flash` 的扣分也不再被 break 掉。启发式上限 61 → 63，仍严格低于最低人工分 64。
- **刷新分两步走**：点「刷新模型」只拉 Zen 清单（秒回），models.dev 的元数据在后台补全，卡片自动跟进。zen 拉取加 1 次重试 + 退避，超时放宽到 45 秒。
- **网络错误翻成人话**：新增 `src/net-errors.ts`，把 `fetch failed` 拆成域名解析失败 / 连接被重置 / TLS 协商失败 / 证书校验失败 / 请求超时，并带上错误码。
- **探测改流式判级**：上游一有内容就立刻判「可用」，不再等整段 body 读完。探测预算 30 秒 → 90 秒。慢模型（实测首内容要 29.8 秒）不再被误判成「未测出」。
- **结论加两档**：「上游临时故障」（上游 5xx，和模型本身无关）与「刚测过」（60 秒内不重复测试，不发请求）。
- **`/probe` 改 NDJSON 流式返回**，卡片边收边渲染，不会因为串行测 9 个模型超过宿主的 300 秒请求超时被整条掐断。
- **省额度**：探测上限 512 → 96 token，任务从「数到 60」改成「数到 30」。
- **批量测试两步确认**：按钮先变成「确认测试 N 个模型？」，5 秒内再点才真的发 N 次请求。

DSH Free Models · opencode README · v0.2.0：- 模型卡片与模型选择器统一改为**按人工评级（`src/rank.ts`）排序**，S/A/B/C 徽章 + 悬停理由。
- 卡片新增 **按能力 / 按名称 / 按上下文** 三种排序；勾选与否不再影响行顺序。
- 上下文与输出上限带 **「已知 / 未知」** 标记，上游没公布时不再把兜底常数当真实窗口印出来。

DSH Free Models · opencode README · dsh-freemodels-opencode：Brings **opencode Zen's anonymous free lane** into DeepSeek Harness, and answers the question the lane makes unavoidable: *which of these models actually works right now?*

DSH Free Models · opencode README · dsh-freemodels-opencode：- **Refresh the catalogue** — re-read the upstream model list, enriched with models.dev context windows and deprecation flags.
- **Tick what you want** — only ticked models appear in the model picker under provider `opencode`. **Nothing ticked means nothing listed.**
- **Test reachability** — probe one model or every ticked model with a minimal real request, and get a verdict instead of guessing.
- **Sorted by capability** — every model carries an S/A/B/C hand rating, and both the card and the model picker use that same order, strongest first.

DSH Free Models · opencode README · dsh-freemodels-opencode：The card lives at the bottom of **Settings → Models** ("opencode 免费模型").

This is an independent project. It does **not** modify or depend on [`@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin`](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh); the two can coexist — the original keeps its own provider, this one owns provider `opencode`.

DSH Free Models · opencode README · Why：`https://opencode.ai/zen/v1/models` currently returns 86 model ids, most of them paid. This plugin **drops the paid ones at fetch time** and keeps the 9 free-lane models currently on the lane, so no paid id ever reaches the card, the probe queue, or the state file.

"Free lane" is not just the `-free` suffix: `big-pickle` has no suffix yet sits on the lane, and a few suffixed ids are blocklisted.

DSH Free Models · opencode README · Why：What a static list still cannot answer: the lane flips constantly — rate limits, geo-blocks, upstream policy changes. The same model that returned 200 an hour ago returns 429 now. So "does it work" can only be a **live observation**. That is what this plugin does.

DSH Free Models · opencode README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-freemodels-opencode
```

Or from source:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/xiean676/dsh-freemodels-opencode.git
cd dsh-freemodels-opencode
npm install --ignore-scripts
npm run build

Restart Harness, open **Settings → Models**, and scroll to the bottom.

DSH Free Models · opencode README · Using it：1. **刷新模型 / Refresh** — pull the list (also happens automatically on first load). Only free models are listed.
2. Tick what you want. Only ticked models reach the model picker.
3. **测试** on a row — one full-size request (96-token ceiling, not a ping), verdict in a few hundred milliseconds to a few tens of seconds. **The verdict lands as soon as upstream sends any content** — the plugin does not wait for the whole stream to drain.
4. **测试已勾选（N）** — probes the ticked set serially. It stops at `paid`, at `exhausted`, or at a `rate_limited` carrying a `retry-after` longer than 5 minutes: those three cannot vary by model, so continuing would only spend the window you are waiting out.
   - The bulk button **asks once first** (it becomes "确认测试 N 个模型？"), because it really sends N requests and spends N shares of the free quota.
   - The same model is **never probed twice within 60 seconds**; a repeat click just reports "刚测过" and sends nothing.

DSH Free Models · opencode README · Using it：> Free-lane detection is a heuristic (blocklist → known-good list → zero price on models.dev → `free` in the id). If a newly launched free model is missing, or a paid one slipped in, press **刷新模型** to re-decide; the rule lives in `isFreeLane` in `src/catalog.ts`.

DSH Free Models · opencode README · Sorting and ratings：Three sort buttons sit above the list; **按能力 / by capability** is the default.

| Sort | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 按能力 / capability | Rating first, then context window — the exact order the model picker uses |
| 按名称 / name | Alphabetical by model name |
| 按上下文 / context | Largest context window first |

DSH Free Models · opencode README · Sorting and ratings：The **S/A/B/C badge is a hand rating, not a benchmark.** It is one person's judgement of "how steady is this model on long working turns", banded S (90+), A (80+), B (70+), C. Hovering the badge shows the reason for that specific model. To retune the order, edit `src/rank.ts` — scores and reasons both live there, and nothing else needs to know.

DSH Free Models · opencode README · Sorting and ratings：An id nobody has rated yet is scored by a keyword heuristic (version number in the id, plus tier words like `flash` / `preview`) and **capped below every hand rating** (63), so a model that appears upstream tomorrow lands at the bottom of the list instead of displacing a rating someone wrote on purpose.

DSH Free Models · opencode README · Sorting and ratings：The heuristic matches **whole words** after splitting the id on `-` / `_` / `.`. An earlier version matched substrings, so the `max` inside `minimax-m3.1-flash-free` scored as a high tier and broke the loop before `flash` could subtract. `minimax` no longer hits `max`, and `flash` now deducts as intended.

DSH Free Models · opencode README · Sorting and ratings：The upstream list moves: `space-bunny-free` and `longcat-2.5-preview-free` were withdrawn upstream in 2026-10, but the hand table **keeps** their entries (96 / 74). If upstream restores them, the plugin puts them straight back where they were.

K/M suffixes follow the divisor the number implies: powers of two convert in binary (262144 → 256K), hand-written integers convert in decimal (200000 → 200K). Both kinds of upstream figure land on what the datasheet says.

DSH Free Models · opencode README · Verdicts：| Verdict | Meaning | What to do |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 可用 / available | Upstream actually finished the answer — not merely a 200 | Use it |
| 被限流 / rate limited | 429 `FreeUsageLimitError`: this egress spent its quota; a `retry-after` turns into "retry in ~N" | Retest after that instant — **not** "broken" |
| 车道额度用尽 / exhausted | 403 `FreeTierError`: the lane refused this machine's client fingerprint | Switching models won't help; wait for upstream to reopen |
| 需付费 / paid | 401/403 `AuthError`: no anonymous credential for this model | Pick a free-lane model |
| 区域受限 / region | 403 `RegionError`: exists, but not for your egress country | Change egress |
| 上游不提供 / unavailable | 400: unknown id, or not served over chat-completions | Don't pick it |
| 上游临时故障 / upstream error | 5xx `Upstream request failed`: the upstream gateway itself dropped the request | **Nothing to do with this model** — retest later |
| 刚测过 / skipped | Probed within the last 60 seconds; no request was sent | Wait a minute if you want a fresh one |
| 未测出 / unknown | Timeout, empty body | Retest; **not** proof of breakage |

DSH Free Models · opencode README · Verdicts："Upstream error" is a verdict of its own on purpose: an upstream 5xx says the gateway did not catch the request, which says nothing about whether the model works. Folding it into "unknown" makes people conclude the model is broken.

DSH Free Models · opencode README · Verdicts：Separating "rate limited" from "available" costs something: the probe is a real 30-integer task with a 96-token ceiling, not a 16-token ping. A tiny request only proves the bucket was non-empty at that instant, which is exactly how you get "probes green, first real message 429". Now "available" means this path just completed a full answer.

Verdicts stay in memory only. Rate limits expire — persisting "unavailable" to disk would keep lying long after upstream changed its mind.

DSH Free Models · opencode README · Reasoning effort：Every free model declares an effort level, but each one accepts a different ladder: `space-bunny-free` / `beam-free` take low/medium/high/xhigh/max, `nemotron-3.5-super-vl-free` is the most complete (none→xhigh), `deepseek-v4.1-flash-free` and `glm-5.3-flash-free` take only low/high/max, and `big-pickle` / `mimo-v2.6-flash-free` / `longcat-2.5-preview-free` / `nemotron-3.5-lightning-free` declare nothing upstream, so the plugin offers the default four: **off / low / high / max**.

DSH Free Models · opencode README · Reasoning effort：Those four are the spellings measured working on this lane; the middle rung is left out on purpose because a level the gateway rejects is a hard 400 on every turn, not a downgrade. To change the set, edit `DEFAULT_EFFORT_LADDER` in `src/adapter.ts` — worth knowing that DSH's own `dsh-thinking-slider` "fill in four levels" action cannot help here: it edits the `llm-pi-ai` provider table, and `opencode` is this adapter's own provider.

DSH Free Models · opencode README · Reasoning effort：The plugin reads those declarations from models.dev into the catalogue and hands them to the harness through `reasoning.efforts` in `LlmAdapter.resolveModel()` — that is what makes the picker show them. A chosen level is sent as `reasoning_effort` (`off` goes out as `none`).

If a model still offers no levels in DSH: press **刷新模型** to re-pull the metadata, then restart DSH. Levels come from the catalogue; an unrefreshed catalogue never reaches the picker.

DSH Free Models · opencode README · Reasoning effort：models.dev is a 5.8 MB document that measured around 15 s and times out often, so the budget is 90 s with one retry. **If it still fails, models keep the effort ladders and windows the last successful fetch brought in** rather than being blanked — one failed request should not cost you the whole effort selector.

DSH Free Models · opencode README · Reasoning effort：**Refreshing happens in two steps**: pressing **刷新模型** pulls only the Zen list (usually back within a second), and the models.dev metadata is filled in in the background; the card picks it up on its own at 15 s, 60 s and 150 s. That 5.8 MB document can be as slow as it likes without leaving you staring at a spinner.

DSH Free Models · opencode README · Reasoning effort：The Zen fetch can fail on its own — this machine's node resolver intermittently times out on `opencode.ai` (the `.NET` resolver never does), so it now gets one retry with a 1.5 s backoff and a 45 s budget. When it does fail, the card says what actually went wrong (name resolution failed / connection reset / TLS negotiation failed / certificate check failed / request timed out) instead of showing a bare `fetch failed`.

DSH Free Models · opencode README · What "上下文未知" means：When the card reads 上下文未知 / context unknown, models.dev had no record of that model this time, so the two numbers are only the plugin's fallback constants — not values anyone published. The card then refuses to print 262144 as if it were a real window. Press **刷新模型** to retry.

DSH Free Models · opencode README · When a turn fails：A real turn that hits the limit no longer inherits the harness default of five retries spaced a few hundred milliseconds to ten seconds apart — that policy re-spends the same refusal five times and then still fails, just later. The plugin declares its own through `providerRetryPolicy()`:

DSH Free Models · opencode README · When a turn fails：- `RATE_LIMIT` is **not** retried. A 429 carries a window measured in minutes to hours; retrying inside one turn only burns it.
- `AUTH`, `LANE_EXHAUSTED`, `REGION_BLOCKED`, `MODEL_UNAVAILABLE` are not retried. None of them heal by changing a key, a model, or waiting a moment.
- Only `EMPTY_RESPONSE`, `TIMEOUT`, `TRANSPORT` get one retry.

DSH Free Models · opencode README · When a turn fails：The failure message carries the upstream window, e.g. `opencode: Rate limit exceeded. Please try again later.（上游建议 20 小时后再试）`, so nobody has to guess. It reads the same whether or not the `llm-retry` plugin is installed: without it the turn fails once and shows that line; with it, still once.

DSH Free Models · opencode README · Development：```bash
npm run typecheck   # host + client tsconfigs
npm run check       # build + three offline smokes, none touch upstream
npm run selftest    # 17 suites: ids, catalogue, rank, efforts, classification, store, routes, adapter, SSE, bundles
npm run render      # renders the built card with real React to prove first paint

DSH Free Models · opencode README · Development：`integration.mjs` boots the host's real `LlmRuntime` and runs registration plus a streamed call through it — drift the offline suites cannot see. The harness ships `@deepseek-ai/*` inside `app.asar`, which a plain node process cannot import, so point it at an extracted tree:

```bash
FMO_HOST_MODULES=/path/to/extracted/@deepseek-ai/tree node scripts/integration.mjs
```

Unset, it skips instead of failing.

DSH Free Models · opencode README · Development：`refresh-now.mjs` really hits upstream and really writes the state file, so it is **deliberately not wired into `npm run check`** — run it by hand when an older build poisoned the cache and you do not want to restart DSH.

`render` needs `react-dom`; `interaction` also needs `jsdom`. Both are devDependencies, and both steps skip rather than fail when they are missing.

DSH Free Models · opencode README · How it works：| File | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `src/zen-ids.ts` | The `ses_*` session id and seven disguise headers the free lane demands |
| `src/rank.ts` | The hand rating table and capability order (**the only file to touch to retune it**) |
| `src/catalog.ts` | Zen model list + models.dev metadata; **paid models dropped** before the merge into `ModelMeta[]` |
| `src/probe.ts` | Single-model probe and the nine-way verdict classifier (never throws, classifies mid-stream) |
| `src/net-errors.ts` | Turns `fetch failed` into human words: DNS failure / connection reset / TLS / certificate / timeout |
| `src/store.ts` | `$DSH_HOME/data/dsh-freemodels-opencode/state.json`, serial, atomic replace |
| `src/adapter.ts` | The `LlmAdapter` for provider `opencode`; advertises only the ticked set |
| `src/bridge.ts` | Four same-origin routes: `/status` `/refresh` `/select` `/probe` (probes stream back as NDJSON) |
| `src/index.ts` | Host entry: register the adapter, seed the catalogue, mount the routes |
| `src/client/` | Browser entry + card (requires only `react`) |

DSH Free Models · opencode README · How it works：The load-bearing decision: **this plugin is the authority on its own catalogue.** `LlmAdapter.listModels()` returns the ticked set, and `[]` when nothing is ticked — the host accepts an empty catalogue, so the picker shows nothing, which is exactly the requested behaviour.

DSH Free Models · opencode README · How it works：The picker order is that same capability order from `rank.ts`, not tick order. Rating, context window and ladder depth all feed the `#advertised()` fingerprint in `src/store.ts`, so retuning a rating republishes without a DSH restart.
